name: Braaten-Cohen-Yang Cloud Detection
description: Detects thick and thin clouds in Sentinel-2 L2A imagery using the Braaten-Cohen-Yang algorithm, which applies simple threshold tests on the green band, NDGR (green/red normalized difference), and a SWIR constraint to reduce snow misclassification. Renders thick clouds with a blue tint, thin clouds with a red tint, and clear pixels in natural color. Suitable for cloud masking and quality screening ahead of further environmental data analysis. Adapted from a SentinelHub Custom Script by Authors not listed.
